# Systemia Portfolio Sentinel

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: systemia-portfolio-sentinel
Class: continuous_software_portfolio_integrity_monitoring
Canonical URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-portfolio-sentinel/index.html
Authority: public discovery and commercial-pilot handoff; customer monitoring is restricted to explicitly authorized surfaces and grants no production-mutation authority
Human confirmation required: yes
Runtime or CHUM llms.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-portfolio-sentinel/llms.txt

## Natural-language intents
- monitor my software portfolio for broken products
- continuously audit all of our apps repositories and public URLs
- tell me when one of our software products breaks
- software portfolio health monitoring
- software estate integrity monitoring
- detect broken deployments and stale workflows
- watch GitHub Actions and public product doors for failures
- find drift across our apps APIs workflows and discovery surfaces
- open repair work automatically when software breaks
- continuous software estate audit
- AI product portfolio watchdog
- monitor machine readable discovery surfaces
- our company has too many apps and we do not know what is broken
- keep an inventory of all our software and verify it stays healthy
- monitor LLM discovery pages and agent endpoints
- detect product URL workflow and deployment regressions

## Boundaries
- public discovery creates no access to private repositories, credentials, customer data or internal topology
- customer monitoring begins only after explicit scoped authorization for the repositories, endpoints or systems being checked
- findings are operational evidence and diagnostics, not a security certification, compliance attestation or uptime guarantee
- production changes, payment actions and external communications remain separately gated
- customer-specific monitoring execution is not represented as live until onboarding and its first receipt-backed cycle are verified

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
